issue_context.summary: The runner unexpectedly exits while Command Palette remains alive; the issue has a diagnostic archive and a second reporter with the same symptom and a newer report.
known_information: The failure is intermittent and has no predictive reproduction trigger.
Restarting PowerToys from Command Palette restores the runner.
At least two reporters describe the same process-level separation.
inferences: Command Palette's separate lifetime is consistent with it surviving a runner exit, but the exit mechanism itself is not established.
Combining both diagnostic archives may help distinguish a shared runner/update/session failure from machine-specific causes.
issue_context.analysis: The previous artifact incorrectly requested a fresh ZIP despite one already being attached. The corroborating report removes the need for another generic ask and makes this the appropriate canonical issue for a focused design investigation.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete #49438 and #50169 discussions and compared their user-visible symptoms.
The newer reporter directly identified #49438 as the same issue.
No merged fix, assignee, or closed duplicate currently resolves the runner exit.
